notes: Hardening patch. Dates are now computed from local time instead of UTC (PH is UTC+8, so sales between midnight and 8 AM were being booked under yesterday's date - today sales, daily reports, refund totals and the LAN week series are now correct). The LAN/mobile access token is generated with crypto.randomBytes(24) instead of Math.random. Backup exports (JSON file, email, encrypted, and the LAN fallback dump) now mask secret settings - SMTP password, cloud backup password, SMS and AI API keys - instead of shipping them in plaintext; restoring such a backup only requires re-entering those values.
